notes.title: More improvement, notes and achievements!
notes.content:
Hey all!

We are happy to say that we just released a new update. This update includes:

- More improved and better answers from Emma
- Improved and some additional clue notes
- A couple of more achievements
- There is now hotkeys (F-function keys) to open up the notebook/history/etc directly from in-game
- Some other minor bugs and fixes

As always - Thanks for playing and giving us feedback!

It is thanks to all your feedback, we know what we should focus on :)

notes.title: More & Improved Answers
notes.content:
Hey all!

We just wanted to say that we have done some updates to the game!

- We've improved and additional answers to the game!
- We've also added more achievements
- Lastly, as you might have noticed, we have changed the game's logotype and art-work outside the game!

As always, we also would like to thank everyone who continuously gives us feedback!

We appreciate all the feedback we are getting on all our channels (from in-game to DMs) in order to improve the game! Thank you!
